P1.1.text: Insurance and Risk Management Brokerage | Brown & Brown

P1.2.text: Explore insurance, risk management and consulting solutions from Brown & Brown. Helping you protect assets, manage exposure, and support long-term growth.

P1.3.text: Delivering solutions for you, every step of the way

P1.4.text: Insurance, Risk Management, and Employee Benefits Solutions

P1.5.text: Brown & Brown brings insurance, risk management, and employee benefits together to help businesses and individuals navigate risk with confidence and clarity. No matter where you are on your growth journey – whether you are a highly complex multinational enterprise, an individual, or anything in between – our experienced teams can help find solutions at every stage.

P1.6.text: Business doesn’t stay still, and neither do we. From day-to-day risk considerations to long-term planning, Brown & Brown offers coordinated solutions designed to adapt as needs evolve.

P1.7.text: Insurance solutions to help organizations manage risk, protect assets, and support ongoing operations.

P2.2.text: Explore Real Estate Insurance and Risk Management solutions from Brown & Brown for property, liability, and compliance exposures, with support tailored to your business.

P2.4.text: Innovative and Data-Driven Insurance Solutions for Real Estate Portfolios

P2.5.text: Insurance and risk management issues differ by real estate asset class, often in nuanced ways. With Brown & Brown, you have specialists and resources for each asset type: office, retail, industrial, hospitality, multifamily, community associations, student housing, and others. We collaborate with you as an outsourced risk manager and insurance advisor to help safeguard your portfolio.

P2.6.text: Leveraging Advanced Analytics to Strengthen Real Estate Risk Management

P2.7.text: In an industry where each decision carries substantial financial weight, ongoing evaluation of your risk profile is crucial. We lead with data — before each renewal and real estate transaction — to help you avoid costly missteps and protect your investments:

P2.8.text: Exposure analysis and CAT modeling: We evaluate fire danger and other catastrophic risks, crime scores, flood mapping, and building valuation to help ascertain geographic vulnerabilities and inform your program structure and limits.

P2.9.text: Power BI heat mapping: Brown & Brown arrays your total insurable values on a map to identify areas with the highest concentrations of risk, so you can make strategic portfolio decisions.

data.offering_description: Operates a franchise network of independent insurance agencies that help individuals and small businesses shop and buy auto, home, life and commercial coverage from multiple carriers, earning commissions when policies are placed.

data.primary_services: insurance brokerage; personal auto and home coverage placement; life insurance placement; commercial insurance placement

data.customer_segment: B2C: households buying personal auto, home, renters and life insurance; B2B: small and mid-sized businesses buying commercial insurance

data.end_markets: personal insurance; small business insurance; life and financial protection

data.revenue_model: commissions or management fees: carrier commissions paid when customers buy policies placed by its agencies; other: royalties and fees paid by franchisees that operate the agency locations

data.value_chain_position: service provider: places insurance coverage and advises customers, sold to households and businesses; distributor: sells insurance carriers' policies through its franchised agencies to consumers and businesses

data.geography_served: US national: nationwide across the United States through franchised agency locations

data.specialization: related lines: personal auto, home, life and commercial insurance lines sharing customers and agency channels

data.distribution_channels: direct sales: agents selling coverage by phone and in person to customers; online: online quote and purchase of insurance coverage; other: franchised independent agency locations operated by franchisees

data.regulatory_exposure: high: state insurance producer licenses required to sell policies, regulated by state departments of insurance

data.offering_description: Operates a personal lines insurance distribution platform that sells home, auto, umbrella and other personal insurance policies from many carriers to individual consumers. Policies are sold through a corporate sales team and a network of franchise agencies. Earns commissions from carriers and royalties from franchisees.

data.primary_services: insurance brokerage for homeowners, auto, umbrella and flood policies; franchise support and technology for franchisees; policy renewal and client service

data.customer_segment: B2C: individual homeowners and drivers buying personal insurance; B2B: franchise owners operating Goosehead-branded agencies, small commercial clients

data.end_markets: personal insurance; home and auto insurance; property and casualty insurance

data.revenue_model: commissions or management fees: new business and renewal commissions paid by insurance carriers, plus contingent commissions; licensing or royalties: royalty fees and initial franchise fees from franchisees; service fees: technology and other fees paid by franchisees

data.geography_served: US national: licensed in nearly all US states, with franchises concentrated in Texas and other states

data.specialization: related lines: personal lines insurance brokerage, franchising, and some commercial lines

data.regulatory_exposure: high: insurance agency licensing by state insurance departments, franchise regulation by the FTC and state laws

P1.2.text: Smarter insurance, by design. Goosehead compares 150+ carriers for home insurance, auto, and bundled coverage at the best price. Get a quote in minutes.

P1.3.text: Goosehead is a full service property and casualty insurance agency. Coverages may not be available in all states or for all insurance companies. The description of coverage is for informational purposes only. Actual coverages will vary based on local laws, product availability, and the terms of the policy issued.

P1.4.text: Disclaimer: This information is not intended as an offer to sell, or the solicitation of an offer to buy, a franchise. It is for informational purposes only. We will not offer you a franchise unless we have complied with applicable pre-sale registration and disclosure documents in your state. Currently, the following states regulate the offer and sale of franchises: California, Hawaii, Illinois, Indiana, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, New York, North Dakota, Rhode Island, South Dakota, Virginia, Washington, and Wisconsin. Within the U.S.A., we offer franchises solely by means of our Franchise Disclosure Document (FDD). There are also countries outside the U.S.A. that have laws governing the offer and sale of franchises. If you are a resident of one of these states or countries, we will not offer you a franchise unless and until we have complied with pre-sale registration and disclosure requirements that apply in your jurisdiction.

P2.2.text: Leading the way for our clients and our industry.

P2.3.text: real estate investor Robyn Jones and her husband Mark Jones, a senior partner at Bain & Co., founded Goosehead Insurance and began transforming the insurance industry by providing clients unprecedented information and product choice. Goosehead has since grown into a national leader by following one simple principle: putting the client at the center of our universe and building the business around them. We provide a wide array of options by shopping the market on our clients’ behalf, educating them, and helping them select the right protection with the right insurance carrier at the best value.
